ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first rural health assistant providing preventive care, outbreak tracking, and vaccination schedules via low-bandwidth audio.
ideas.title: GraminSwasthya
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets rural Indian community challenges by solving accessibility issues for semi-urban and rural populations, echoing proven multilingual health awareness wins.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered app connecting elderly citizens in urban Indian neighborhoods with verified volunteer drivers for routine social outings and medical visits.
ideas.title: SahayakDriver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses urban loneliness and elderly care mobility issues, aligning with the hackathon's mission to solve real-time urban community challenges.

ideas.pitch: Real-time disaster management and crowd-sourced relief coordination platform tailored for flood and landslide-prone Indian districts.
ideas.title: AapdaNet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact social crisis management with a live working prototype that judges can test instantly on their phones.

ideas.pitch: An AI marketing and inventory copilot for local rural artisans and street vendors to instantly digitize products and reach nearby buyers.
ideas.title: Gram Bazaar Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Drives tangible economic upliftment for rural-urban micro-entrepreneurs, hitting the core objective of building practical tools for Indian communities.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first agent running locally on edge devices that detects and intercepts financial scam calls targeting elderly family members in regional languages.
ideas.title: SurakshaVoice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a widespread cybercrime issue affecting vulnerable demographics across India with advanced voice AI engineering.
